moves.title: Fact reinforcement loop: recall-usage feeds salience and decay resistance
moves.why: Rules mature via helpful/harmful outcomes but facts get no utility signal (storage.py:1809-1824 tracks usage only on predicate_registry; search.py:377,409 scoring ignores usage). Vision's success marker is the mental labor the system reliably absorbs plus earned calm: the graph should strengthen what it uses and let write-once noise fade. Payoff: retrieval self-prioritizes load-bearing knowledge; never-recalled facts become honest pruning candidates. Serves the memory module (all 9 hosting butlers) and mirrors the relationship manifesto's 'attention flows inward' for facts.
moves.integration_points: memory module: add usage_count/last_used_at to facts (new mem migration mirroring predicate_registry cols at migrations/001:416); increment on recall-into-context in tools/context.py + search.py recall path; feed a bounded utility term into composite score (search.py:386-409) and decay resistance in effective_confidence (search.py:418-437); extend memory-retention-policy + module-memory specs.
moves.slice_plan: (1) migration + write-side increment on memory_context injection, no scoring change; (2) add utility term to composite score behind a weight; (3) couple utility to decay resistance and expose never-recalled fade candidates in /api/memory/stats.

moves.title: Corroboration-weighted decay resistance (independent multi-source confirmation)
moves.why: confirm_memory only resets last_confirmed_at (storage.py:2478-2489); a lone assertion and one corroborated by five distinct sessions decay identically (search.py:428). The relationship manifesto holds confidence immutable ('changed certainty is a new, superseding assertion'), so trust breadth must live on a SEPARATE axis, not by mutating confidence. Payoff: widely-corroborated knowledge survives while lone-source claims fade fastest, so uncertainty never impersonates settled fact. Serves the memory module and respects relationship's confidence-immutability doctrine.
moves.integration_points: memory module: add a corroboration counter (distinct source session_id/source_schema asserting the same subject-predicate-object) on the store_fact merge/supersession path (storage.py store_fact); apply it as a decay_rate multiplier in effective_confidence (search.py:418-437), orthogonal to confidence; document the second axis in memory-retention-policy + relationship-facts specs.
moves.slice_plan: (1) count distinct corroborating sources at store-time, persist on facts.metadata; (2) derive a decay-resistance factor from the count; (3) surface corroboration breadth in the fact dossier / graph-health panel.

moves.title: Deterministic cross-butler entity-fact read federation (RFC-0010 read view)
moves.why: Cross-butler knowledge today is a summary catalog hit (docs/modules/memory.md:194) or a full LLM delegation session (cross-butler-delegation spec); no zero-spend structured read exists (grep: no cross-schema fact views). Vision names 'shared situational awareness' as core, and doctrine rule 3 explicitly permits read-only SQL views for deterministic batch aggregation via RFC 0010. Payoff: Finance learns a payee is the owner's brother, or Health sees a relationship's dietary fact, without spawning a session: shared awareness at zero LLM cost. Serves the ecosystem/vision; implies a new RFC amendment under legends-and-lore.
moves.integration_points: new RFC (about/legends-and-lore/) authorizing a narrow read-only cross-schema view keyed by public.entities.entity_id with a sensitivity ceiling; the view reads active facts across butler schemas; wire into memory read path + entity-identity and database-security specs; a butler may read only facts about entities it already touches.
moves.slice_plan: (1) RFC + guardrails (sensitivity ceiling, entity-membership gate, audit); (2) read-only view + role grants for a single consumer pair (Finance<-Relationship); (3) generalize to the entity graph with per-read audit rows.

moves.title: Proposed-predicate promotion & canonicalization loop
moves.why: Novel predicates enter as status='proposed' with usage_count/aliases/inverse_of already tracked (storage.py:1786, migrations/001:427) but no loop promotes or canonicalizes them; the relational-edges change shows the symptom: free-form predicates (planned_dinner_with, wake_coordination) that cannot be aggregated. Payoff: the graph's edge vocabulary stays bounded and queryable as it grows (the 'scalably' half of the pursuit question) instead of rotting into one-off strings. Serves the memory module; routes decisions through the Owner Decision Desk (bu-ckkpz).
moves.integration_points: memory module scheduled job over predicate_registry: cluster high-usage 'proposed' predicates, propose canonical adoption or alias-mapping (using existing aliases/inverse_of/superseded_by columns) as decision beads; predicate-taxonomy + module-memory specs. Distinct from relationship-curation's episodic-predicate-cleanup (that deletes one-off relationship predicates; this promotes cross-butler vocabulary).
moves.slice_plan: (1) read-only report of top proposed predicates by usage across schemas; (2) owner decision to promote/alias one; (3) apply canonical mapping + backfill facts to the canonical predicate.

moves.title: Active re-verification of high-value stale facts (decay becomes a question, not silent rot)
moves.why: The decay sweep silently fades facts (docs/modules/memory.md:122-137); a high-importance fact anchored to an inner-circle entity erodes with no owner signal. The relationship manifesto makes 'reach-out reminders the natural mechanism that arrests the drift' for people; facts deserve the same. Vision demands nothing fabricated and staleness never wearing current-data authority. Payoff: the graph asks 'is X still true?' for load-bearing knowledge instead of quietly serving stale beliefs. Serves the relationship manifesto (arrest-the-drift for facts) and the memory module.
moves.integration_points: decay sweep (memory maintenance): when a fact crossing into 'fading' is high-importance AND anchored to a high-Dunbar-tier entity, emit a bounded owner re-verification prompt via notify()/decision instead of a silent transition; weight selection by dunbar-tier-scoring; extend memory-retention-policy spec.
moves.slice_plan: (1) classify fade-eligible facts by importance x entity tier; (2) rate-limited re-verification notification for the top slice; (3) one-tap confirm/retract that resets or expires via existing confirm/forget.

moves.title: Per-entity fact-cardinality compaction (scalable graph guardrail)
moves.why: There is no per-entity fact budget; high-touch entities accumulate unbounded facts that noise up memory_context and entity_neighbors. The pursuit asks how the graph grows scalably: a single-user graph still needs bounded per-entity density to keep context assembly sharp. Payoff: retrieval and neighbor reads stay crisp as the graph ages; low-salience facts fold into provenance-linked summaries rather than being lost or hoarded. Serves the memory module; complements bu-27dxl.4's provenance edges (summary facts link back to sources).
moves.integration_points: consolidation (consolidation_executor.py): when an entity's active-fact count exceeds a salience-ranked budget, consolidate low-salience facts into a summary fact with memory_links back to sources; entity neighbors + memory_context assembly (tools/context.py); memory-discovery-catalog for summary cataloging.
moves.slice_plan: (1) per-entity fact-count + salience report; (2) summarize-and-link the lowest-salience tail for one over-budget entity; (3) generalize with a configurable budget and reversible compaction.

audits.jarvis_gap: Today the conversational layer is two disconnected silos with no honesty spine between them. Dashboard chat is durable and lineage-tracked (`public.dashboard_conversations`/`dashboard_messages`, `conversations.py`) but Telegram/email/WhatsApp conversations are stateless per-flush classification batches — the butler answering a follow-up has only the connector's fetched history window (`telegram-user-client-conversation-history`, 50-msg window), never its own prior-session memory, and a Telegram thread with the health butler is a different memory than a dashboard thread with the same butler. A cross-channel substrate already exists — `switchboard.message_inbox` records both inbound and delivered-outbound rows with `direction` and `source_thread_identity` (`001_switchboard_messaging.py:212-290`; `deliver.py:_write_outbound_message_inbox`) — but nothing surfaces it: there is no Conversations page in the frontend nav, and the chat widget reads only the dashboard silo. Worst, delivery is silent-fail: `messenger.delivery_requests.status` can be `dead_lettered` (`001_messenger_tables.py`) while the owner sees nothing, directly violating the north star that failure never impersonates health. Ideal: one channel-agnostic conversation ledger anchored on `(source_channel, source_thread_identity)`, every message carrying a visible delivery/receipt state on the signal→session→evidence spine, durable continuity across the dashboard/Telegram boundary, structured action receipts with inline undo, multi-modal inbound capture, and conversational capability discovery — the messenger's outbound plane and the switchboard's inbound plane fused into a single honest, keyboard-first conversational surface.

audits.ideal: The system carries a rich edge-trigger spine — connector ingestion → discretion → switchboard, cron scans, calendar/deadline projection, event-chains, and a central insight broker with dedup/cooldown/verbosity/quiet-hours (openspec/specs/proactive-insight-engine, insight-delivery). In the ideal, that spine is complemented by a first-class level-condition layer for the owner: durable domain conditions that open, persist, auto-resolve on snapshot evidence, and re-escalate on aging (exactly the infra-conditions lifecycle already proven for reliability), so a still-true "overdue bill" or "refill due" is one standing citizen rather than a re-fired candidate every scan. Quiet windows are presence-aware, not just clock-aware: delivery consults the situational context bus (dnd/meeting/sleeping/traveling) so nudges land when the owner is actually reachable, and briefings hold to first-active rather than a fixed cron minute. Owners can declare standing subscriptions — "watch X, tell me on this edge" — as a unified declarative registry with explicit level-vs-edge semantics. And numeric connector telemetry (vitals, focus/idle, running spend, sensors) is watched at ingestion time so a threshold crossing fires immediately instead of waiting for the next cron scan.
audits.jarvis_gap: Today proactivity is almost entirely edge-triggered and scan-based: every butler re-proposes insight candidates on a cron and relies on dedup/cooldown to suppress repeats, which structurally cannot represent a persisting owner-facing condition (open→aging→resolved) — that lifecycle exists only for infrastructure (src/butlers/core/infra_conditions.py, explicitly infra-only per its docstring and run-06 bu-27dxl.6). Quiet windows are static clock hours in approvals_policy (proactive-insight-engine spec lines 156-181); the situational context bus (public.user_context: dnd/meeting/sleeping/traveling, openspec/specs/context-bus) is never consulted by the delivery cycle, so an insight can fire mid-meeting or while traveling despite the vision's situational-awareness mandate (about/heart-and-soul/vision.md:9-11). There is no owner-declared standing subscription primitive; the calendar overcommitment radar is read-time only (no notify/insight emission in src/butlers/jobs/calendar_overlay.py or calendar_workspace.py), so overloaded days never warn proactively; and numeric connector telemetry only reaches a butler as a forwarded message via discretion or on the next scan — there is no ingestion-time threshold watcher for vitals/focus/spend/sensors.
